critique: The render strongly captures the Wild World character: fine magenta particle filaments form a large organic, turbulent ribbon-field on black, with a bright tangled interior and clear motion between frames 1 and 4. Compared with the prior result, the mass is more coherently centered. However, the world remains oversized and heavily clipped along the bottom and both sides, so it reads as a close-up slice rather than a complete, balanced preset composition. The asymmetric off-frame displacement is still apparent in both frames.

suggestions.why: Recenter the Kaleidospace/world center at the comp center; the current large negative X/Y center is the most likely source of the persistent asymmetric, cropped framing.
Reduce the world scale moderately after recentering so more of the organic structure fits within frame boundaries while preserving the dense Wild World filament character.
